title: Rooftop Deck | 10 Min Downtown | Offstreet Parking
description:
Welcome to our stylish and contemporary 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhome located in the heart of East Nashville, Tennessee. This urban retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, making it an ideal choice for families, couples, or small groups looking to explore the vibrant culture of Music City. Perfectly located in one of Nashville’s most eclectic neighborhoods. Whether you’re here for a weekend getaway, a music-filled adventure, or a long stay, you’ll feel right at home.

The space
Things to Know:
10 minute drive downtown Nashville
Walk to coffee shops and restaurants
Near Five Points
Dedicated free parking spot off street
Free High Speed Wifi
Central air conditioning and heating
Washer and dryer in unit
Fully stocked Kitchen
2 x Queen Sized bed
Private roof top deck with outdoor dining
Pet Friendly Nashville stay

Our townhome is situated in the heart of East Nashville, one of the city's most eclectic and vibrant neighborhoods. You'll be within walking distance to an array of local shops, trendy boutiques, and a diverse selection of restaurants and cafes. Don't miss the local music venues and bars that give East Nashville its unique charm. Downtown Nashville is just a short drive away, where you can explore iconic attractions such as the Country Music Hall of Fame, Ryman Auditorium, and Broadway's famous honky-tonks.
